## Workshop description

This hands-on workshop introduces practical methods for uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis (UQSA) in computational modelling, with examples drawn from cardiovascular applications.

The workshop follows an intuition-first progression:

- interactive exploration of sensitivity concepts
- interpretation of Sobol sensitivity indices
- uncertainty propagation using Monte Carlo simulation
- practical introduction to polynomial chaos expansions (PCE)

Participants will work directly with Jupyter notebooks throughout the session.

## Learning outcomes

After the workshop, participants should be able to:

- interpret first-order and total Sobol sensitivity indices
- understand how uncertainty propagates through computational models
- implement basic Monte Carlo approaches for uncertainty analysis
- understand the rationale and practical use of polynomial chaos expansions
- identify strengths and limitations of different UQSA approaches
